messages.subject: [R-sig-ME] Introduction to GLMM and GAMM with R — Hybrid course
messages.subject_clean: Introduction to GLMM and GAMM with R — Hybrid course
messages.body_plain:
Join Dr Alain F. Zuur and Dr Elena Ieno for a practical five-day 
introduction to generalised linear mixed-effects models and generalised 
additive mixed models in R.

Topics include random intercepts and slopes, nested models, GLMMs, 
nonlinear relationships, hierarchical GAMs, model selection and 
validation. Examples cover continuous, count, binary and proportional 
data, primarily using glmmTMB and mgcv.

Dates: 17?21 August 2026, 09:00?16:00 (Dutch time)
Location: Brightlands Campus Venlo, the Netherlands, or online via Zoom
Course fee: ?500, including 12 months? access to the course website and 
a one-hour consultation about your own data. All exercises and theory 
presentations are also available as on-demand video.

Flyer: 
https://www.highstat.com/Courses/Flyers/Flyer2026_08_Maastricht_GLMMGAMM.pdf

Information and registration: 
https://www.highstat.com/index.php/joine-an-onsite-course

Kind regards,

Alain Zuur
